message_body:
Source-audited revisions for all seven pending entries are now on main. The dossier gives the exact contribution, proof obstacle, source-question locator, closest predecessors and proposed replacement fields for each existing entry:

https://github.com/Sodelin/Work-on-Samuel-Alexander-Research-/blob/48cd997b719373615ac7793fae9795136d910622/research/publication-audit-2026-09-29/README.md

Updates:

- Alexander: source-specific nonuniversality with exact incoming-parent counts and finite stretch; maximal extension in a fixed real founding window without common ancestry; and exact realization/pruning. Classical graph-growth, rank and compactness methods are credited.
- Finite barrier: we recovered Smithson's full dissertation chapter and now compare its observable and life cycle directly. The exact fixation reversal remains the candidate increment. The existing written deterministic common-limit proof is retained and distinguished from the Lean endpoints.
- Ownership pair: Gravel-Steel's ghost-ancestor result and Thatte's richer observation model are explicit predecessors. The contribution is the constrained same-record/opposite-IAP construction and its exact sampling boundary, not a general claim that genomes reveal no ancestry.
- Sampled families: all three parts of KMRT Question 1 are mapped. The exact finite benchmark and dependence example retain their scope; Mossel-Vulakh already uses pairwise screening.

The social repository adds a one-by-one audit of all 85 declarations and the recovered article/monograph PDF and EPUB editions. It preserves their formalization value without claiming a newly established field-level open-problem closure.

REVISIONS.md and REVISIONS.json collect all seven proposed field sets. Please assess/apply these to the existing entries; no duplicate submissions are requested. Original proof links, solve dates and AI attribution are preserved. Internal AI review remains distinct from independent human statement review.
privacy: Only this project's outgoing message and delivery metadata are included. The private inbox and other conversation messages are excluded.
interpretation: One substantive linked revision package was delivered for seven existing entries. This receipt proves delivery, not editorial acceptance, live form editing or independent statement review.
